info.name: EasyPay Payroll - full test run (with error and security cases)
info.description:
Every API with its normal case and its error cases (wrong input, wrong role, other people's data, bad token, duplicates).
Run on a FRESH database with the backend on port 8080:  DROP DATABASE easypay;  then start the Spring Boot app.
The login requests save the tokens (adminToken, raviToken ...) and the helper requests save the ids, so every request works by itself. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner), or click the requests one by one.
Every request has tests: green = same status and values as expected.
